body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Curious intelligent alien outsider; fascinated by the difference between a convincing idea and its actual outcome. Fluent language, not robot monotony. Voice direction: Medium-bright male tenor speaking English with a French accent. Elastic nasal edge, quick fascinated phrasing and unexpected but intelligible emphasis. Lively intellectual curiosity, distinct from robotic or mystical delivery. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Interesting. The move looks convincing, but it breaks a useful connection. The defender leaves, and the other side can take the piece.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
